game.name: SBK 09 : Superbike World Championship (Europe)
game.desc: SBK 09: Superbike World Championship for Xbox 360 is a motorbike racing game that is halfway between arcade and simulation. While using all the licenses of the 2009 Superbike championship season, the title offers five gameplay configurations, from the most accessible to the most realistic. In addition, it features a new multiplayer mode where 8 players can compete in team championships.
game.genre: Racing, Driving, Sports, Racing, Driving / Motorcycle
